subject: Math
text_verbatim: Chapter 1 Numberland Adventures: Up to 999 6. Which of the following numbers is the smallest? A) 654 B) 645 C) 456 D) 465 7. In the number 578, what is the value of the digit 5? A) 5 B) 50 C) 500 D) 5000 Fill in the blanks 1. The number before 500 is ___. 2. Seventy-two is written as ___ in numerals. 3. In the number 639, the digit 3 represents ___ tens. 4. 544 rounded to the nearest tens is ___. 5. The Roman numeral for 6 is ___. 6. The number after 998 is ___. 7. The number 745 has ___ hundreds. 8. The number before 450 is ___. 9. The ordinal number for 19 is ___. Questions 1. Circle the object in the 4th position. 1st [ball, pacifier, ABC blocks, diaper, stacking rings, bottle, socks, duck, pram, baby monitor] 2. Arrange these numbers in ascending order. 312 321 231 29

exercises.label: MCQ 6
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Which of the following numbers is the smallest? A) 654 B) 645 C) 456 D) 465

exercises.label: MCQ 7
exercises.instruction_verbatim: In the number 578, what is the value of the digit 5? A) 5 B) 50 C) 500 D) 5000
exercises.answer_key: C) 500 (5 is in the hundreds place of 578)

exercises.label: Fill in the blanks 2
exercises.instruction_verbatim: Seventy-two is written as ___ in numerals.

exercises.label: Fill in the blanks 3
exercises.instruction_verbatim: In the number 639, the digit 3 represents ___ tens.
exercises.answer_key: 3 (the digit 3 is in the tens place, i.e. it represents 3 tens = 30)

exercises.label: Fill in the blanks 4
exercises.instruction_verbatim: 544 rounded to the nearest tens is ___.

exercises.label: Fill in the blanks 7
exercises.answer_key: 7 (the digit 7 is in the hundreds place)
